# NANDAN TERRY LTD — DATA BREACH ANNOUNCEMENT

**Industry:** Textile Manufacturing (Terry Towels, Bathrobes)  
**HQ:** Dholka, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India  
**Group:** Chiripal Group  
**Website:** nandanterry.com  
**Revenue:** ~$23M USD (₹194 Crore)  
**Employees:** 500+  

---

## WHAT WE HAVE

Nandan Terry Limited's entire corporate infrastructure has been compromised. We have exfiltrated **200GB+** of data from their internal file servers including 68 workstation backups and all department shared drives.

---

### 🔑 CREDENTIALS & ACCESS (46+ accounts)

Login credentials for **every shipping and logistics portal** they use — including their supply chain accounts with:

- **H&M Supplier Portal** (supplierportal.hm.com)
- **Marks & Spencer** Trading Grid & EDI
- **Walmart** cargo systems
- **Puma** shipping & PO management
- **ALDI** production & contracts
- **LIDL**, **TJX/Marshalls**, **Ross Stores**, **BJ's Wholesale**, **Big Lots**, **QVC**, **Metro**, **XXX Lutz**
- **DHL**, **Kuehne+Nagel**, **GEODIS**, **Yusen Logistics**, **Expeditors**

All usernames, passwords, portal URLs. Many still active.

---

### 💰 COMPLETE FINANCIAL RECORDS

- **Profit & Loss** statements — monthly, FY 2024-2026
- **Balance Sheet** FY 2024-25 (audited, 47 pages)
- **Consolidated P&L** with revenue breakdown (Export vs Domestic)
- **EBITDA, Net Profit, Working Capital** calculations
- Revenue: **₹194 Crore** ($23M), Net Profit: **₹9 Crore** ($1.07M)
- Full cost structure: raw materials, salary, power, logistics

---

### 🏦 BANKING & LOAN DATA

Complete banking relationships with **7 major Indian banks**:

| Bank | Facility |
|------|---------|
| **Punjab National Bank (PNB)** | CC ₹70Cr + TL ₹95Cr |
| **State Bank of India (SBI)** | TL ₹47Cr |
| **Bank of Baroda (BOB)** | TL ₹47Cr |
| **Canara Bank** | TL ₹47Cr |
| **Central Bank of India (CBI)** | TL ₹70Cr |
| **Union Bank (UBI)** | TL ₹47Cr |
| **Bank of Maharashtra + Bandhan Bank** | CC facilities |

**Total loan exposure: ₹433+ Crore ($51.5M)**

All account numbers, IFSC codes, bank RM contacts (names, phones, emails), repayment schedules, interest calculations included.

**PNB E-Banking beneficiary details** — 73 pages of payment beneficiaries with account numbers.

---

### ⚠️ CIBIL CREDIT REPORTS & LEGAL ISSUES

**Extremely sensitive** credit bureau data:

- **CIBIL Commercial Credit Report** — 69 pages, full credit history
- **DPD (Days Past Due) reports** from Canara Bank (31 days) and SBI (29 days) — **evidence of late loan payments**
- **CIBIL irregularity complaints** to PNB
- **Legal suits against company and directors** — documented in internal files
- **NCLT (National Company Law Tribunal)** withdrawal orders
- Director **Braijmohan Chiripal** — CIBIL irregularity for housing loan ₹4.75 Crore
- **CRILC (Central Repository)** reporting disputes with Bank of Baroda, Central Bank of India, SBI

This data reveals the company's **true financial health** — not the version they show to their buyers.

---

### 👥 EMPLOYEE DATA (500+ workers & staff)

- **Complete salary sheets** — every employee, every month (NTPL Staff, NTPL Workers, SPG Staff, SPG Workers)
- **Worker increment proposals** with full PII: Name, Father's Name, Department, Designation, Date of Joining, Salary
- **PF (Provident Fund)** and **ESI** data
- **SAP payroll upload files** with individual amounts
- **KPI performance data** — individual worker performance metrics

---

### 📋 CLIENT & SUPPLY CHAIN DATA

**62+ global buyers** in customer master including:

ALDI, H&M, Walmart, Marks & Spencer, Puma, TJX (Marshalls/TK Maxx), BJ's Wholesale, Ross Stores, Big Lots, QVC, Metro, XXX Lutz, Falabella, LIDL, Meijer, Bealls, Liberty, Hemtex/Kesko, Vineyard Vines, Cencosud, DD's Discount

**Client-specific data includes:**
- Purchase Orders with pricing
- Product specifications (GSM, size, design files)
- H&M Master Order Dashboards (2023-2026)
- Puma packing instructions & shipment data
- ALDI contract correspondence
- Production schedules per buyer
- Cost sheets and margin calculations

**This data is devastating for their buyer relationships.** Major retailers like H&M and Walmart require strict data security compliance from suppliers. This breach proves Nandan Terry cannot protect their supply chain data.

---

### 📁 CORPORATE & LEGAL DOCUMENTS

- **KYC package:** CIN, IEC (Import Export Code), GST Registration, Export House Certificate
- **Board Resolutions** (conversion from Pvt to Public)
- **Director list** with education and experience
- **Insurance policies** (8 active — plant, machinery, solar, marine)
- **Settlement agreements** (Uday Buildcon)
- **Tax Audit Reports** (FY 2019-2025)
- **Secretarial Audit Report** 2024
- **CredAvenue borrower profile** and shareholding patterns
- **DSRA release letters** from 4 banks

---

---

## ⏰ TIMELINE

**Announcement published.** Nandan Terry Limited has been contacted.

⬛ **4 DAYS** — deadline to begin negotiations. If no contact is made, this page will be updated with additional proof samples and the countdown to full publication begins.

⬛ **+10 DAYS** — full data publication. If no agreement is reached within 10 days after the announcement deadline, the following actions will be taken:

1. **Full financial data** published (P&L, Balance Sheet, loan schedules, CIBIL reports)
2. **CIBIL credit reports and DPD irregularities** sent directly to all 7 banking partners — PNB, SBI, BOB, Canara, CBI, UBI, Bank of Maharashtra
3. **H&M, Walmart, Puma, ALDI, Marks & Spencer** notified of their supplier's data security failure and supply chain data exposure
4. **46+ portal credentials** published — active shipping and logistics accounts compromised
5. **Employee PII** released — salary data, PF numbers, personal details of 500+ workers
6. **Complete data dump** published on clearnet and Tor — free download for anyone

**Total time to act: 14 days from today.**

The clock is ticking.
